テキスト cha 474: Born Shiyo 757, December 3. Height 163cm (as of Shiyo 800). Haruka Niimura's mother. She lives next door to the Kogori and has been Akane Kogori's close friend since early childhood. Past 40, she still dresses in the clothes a 20-year-old would wear, and the strain of it is beginning to show. Her speech, in reaction, is that of an older woman.
Disappeared together with Haruka Niimura. Her whereabouts are not known.
She was found dead at the Kogori house, apparently struck on the head with a blunt weapon.
In Shiyo 781 (then 23), she seems to have been making an offering for the dead for someone, and there are signs of a person who presided over the ritual.
She was thought to be the shinigami who chased Natsumi Kogori and Haruka Niimura around Sakuraoka, but she was found as a burned body in a fire at her home.

Mifuyu Niimura confronts Natsumi Kogori in the dress of the shinigami. She hears Natsumi Kogori's apology but answers 'That is not the problem'. Then she throws herself from the roof of the apartment building together with Haruka Niimura and vanishes.
In other routes Mifuyu Niimura herself appeared as the shinigami, but in this route she never shows herself at all.

シナリオ名: Haruka and the Witch and the Shinigami
テキスト cha 474: What end she met is unknown, but at least she seems to have vanished from Motoki-cho.
After the sudden death of her husband, Eiichiro Niimura, she suffers from a mental illness. Because of this she moves with Haruka Niimura to Megasawa City, Iizawa Prefecture.

Erina Goto expects Mifuyu Niimura to kill herself once she has achieved her goal. In the Jusatsu Arc [Killing by Curse], there is no route in which Mifuyu Niimura is confirmed alive after April 8; she either burns to death or goes missing. Given these outcomes, Erina Goto's guess can be said to make some sense.

When she went to Haruka Niimura's parent-teacher meeting, she kept pressing the homeroom teacher, Rei Tanizaki, on whether there really was no bullying. Haruka Niimura says she is fine because she is having a good time, but it is hard to say Mifuyu Niimura is convinced at heart. Ever since the bullying problem in Megasawa City she seems this sensitive about whether Haruka Niimura is being bullied at school, and she trusts neither the school nor the people around her.
In Shiyo 790, just before the first Megasawa City case occurred, she asked people of the Arata settlement to kill the children who were bullying Haruka Niimura, but she seems to have been refused.
Caught in the trap Haruka Niimura set, she is helplessly arrested. Just before that, she apparently tried to use some strange drug.

To Haruka Niimura, who came to visit her, she calls herself a failure as a mother, but the enraged Haruka Niimura denies it as wrong. On the contrary, Haruka tells her there is no mother better than Mifuyu Niimura, and that she is truly grateful for being raised with love all this time.

Mifuyu Niimura had returned to Motoki-cho to watch the Kogori family. Yet her heart can hardly be said to have recovered, and she is desperate to protect their life. After what happened in Megasawa City, she worries terribly that Haruka Niimura may be bullied, and this escalates until she asks Ryoji Kogori to build a bug into Haruka Niimura's smartphone.

Asked by Ryoji Kogori to return Haruka Niimura, she refuses on the spot. But fearing how he might negotiate or threaten her next, she schemes to kill him that day, the eve of April 8, and wipe out his family with him. Following the Megasawa City case, she makes Ryoji as gruesome a body as she can―a flayed body―and tries to kill Akane and Natsumi Kogori on April 8 too. If it works she will flee to the Arata settlement with Haruka Niimura; if not, die together with her.

シナリオ名: A Best Friend and Then Family
テキスト cha 474: She lost her mother at birth and her father around the time she entered high school, leaving her all alone in the world. Clingy by nature, she related to her best friend Akane Kogori in a dependent way, and Akane accepted it with her whole being. However, thinking such a spoiled character was not good, she came to want to become independent quickly and have a family.

シナリオ名: A Best Friend and Then Family
テキスト cha 474: By changing her clothes and posture she came to be viewed favorably by men, but in the end she could not keep up with the change, and years passed with her still bewildered.

Meeting Eiichiro Niimura, whose values and way of thinking are extremely similar to hers, she knows romantic love for the first time. Eiichiro Niimura is short, obese, unattractive, and moreover shy and indecisive, not generally the popular type, but rather than those flaws, what won her heart seems to be that he looks straight at what is inside her.

The day after they first met, her feelings grow stronger through contact with Eiichiro Niimura, so much that she lets words of affection slip in front of him. Right after, when Eiichiro Niimura proposes less than a day after they met, she accepts without the slightest hesitation.

After a year of trial in the Arata settlement, she married Eiichiro Niimura and became pregnant. Akane Kogori became pregnant at almost the same time, and the two dreamed and talked of life with their future families. That matched the form of family she had always held as her ideal; it can truly be called the height of her happiness.

She had a stillbirth and was left unable to bear children, and her dream of having the family she longed for was cut off. However, at the urging of those around her, she resolves to take in the Kogori family's child by adoption. Haruka Niimura and she are mother and daughter with no blood relation.
目の前で新村栄一郎が首を柵に貫かれる瞬間を目撃してしまい、この時から心に影ができ始める。古郡なつみが新村栄一郎に対して何かやったのだろうと疑う。事故から約1月後、新村春花を連れて元木町を去る。

Mifuyu Niimura moved to Megasawa City to heal her heart, but could not hold down a proper job and was forced to live in poverty. Furthermore, she drew up a plan to kill the classmates who bullied Haruka Niimura, and asked the Kogori couple to help her manufacture an alibi.

After attending the thirteenth-year memorial service in the Arata settlement, she visits the grave of the child she had with Eiichiro Niimura, who was stillborn. There her mother-in-law tells her, "If you ever get in trouble, never mind the rule; just take Haruka and run here." Since the two killings in Megasawa City had already been carried out by that hour, she is seized by a feeling that could be taken for regret.

Furious that the Kogori couple did not carry out the murder she requested, she kills everyone except Natsumi Kogori and then burns herself to death. Her reason for burning herself is said to be to destroy the traces of the drug remaining in her body.

Accidentally striking Haruka Niimura with the mace brings her to her senses, but guilt and the fear of being hated leave her dazed. As Natsumi Kogori apologizes for Eiichiro Niimura's fatal accident and offers all she can do to help Haruka, her heart begins to move. Then Haruka tells her the real reason she cursed her classmates, and she sees how foolish her own actions were. Finally, urged by Akane Kogori to return to Motoki-cho, she clears the shadow from her heart.

Unlike the route where the Megasawa City case happens, in the Shigatsu Arc route she has founded a company. Her days are as busy as ever, but she is better off than an ordinary household and no longer takes any job at any hour. In the case route she owned a kei car; in this route, a minivan. Even this well off, she does not seem to intend to move from next door to the Kogori family.

Just before the Megasawa City affair, she asks Sakura Niimura to help kill the two children but is turned down. Yet a few days later the weapons arrive from her, and she sets out to carry out the killing with them. In the Shigatsu Arc she holds back from killing, and confesses to Erika Niimura that she broke the rules by receiving Sakura Niimura's support.
She had told the Kogori couple to hide in the storage shed at Arata Station. She believes that is why disaster struck them.

She told the Kogori couple to hide in the storage shed to keep Natsumi Kogori and the others safe. Because of Natsumi's danger sense, Natsumi and Erina Goto attended the memorial service in the couple's place, but the still-uneasy couple put a bugging app on the smartphones and meant to use that drug to protect the girls if anything happened. The plan failed and put the couple in danger instead, which Mifuyu deeply regrets.

When she married Eiichiro Niimura, she had been told that the people of the Arata settlement kill themselves on turning 75. But without flinching at that, she vows to live the rest of their time to the fullest with Eiichiro Niimura.

To mourn the child she had with Eiichiro Niimura, who died in the womb and could never be born, she visits the communal graveyard with Haruka Niimura. Sensing Haruka's feelings, she worried that this might make Haruka jealous of her own sister, but with the Arata settlement apparently about to come to an end, she lets her visit the grave as a last chance.

Partly to escape the investigation, she has been in the mountain seclusion with her daughter Haruka Niimura. Noticing changes in and around the settlement, she hurries down to it, but is caught off guard and shot dead by Momoko Goto.

シナリオ名: サード・ジェネレーション
テキスト cha 474: She had been plotting to kill Natsumi Kogori, but after the prophecy of Erina Goto, awakened to danger sense, and after Haruka Niimura learns who she is and bares her heart to her, she thinks better of it and turns herself in.

シナリオ名: パラサイト・プリズン
テキスト cha 474: In Shiyo 800, she flees Motoki-cho for the Arata settlement with Haruka Niimura, but using Droga puts too much strain on her body, and she dies right after reaching the settlement. However, using Droga has qualified her as a divine messenger, so she is reborn as one.

シナリオ名: メガミゴロシミナゴロシ
テキスト cha 474: On Shiyo 800, April 8, Eiichiro Niimura, revived as a divine messenger, pushes her down the stairs and she dies. She too is reborn as a divine messenger, but because she used only a little Droga, her human self remains to some degree; she disrupts 'the Rite of Prosperity' and rescues Haruka Niimura and the others. Her whereabouts after that are unknown.

In Tokyo on business, she contacts Chigaya Niimura to suggest lunch. When Chigaya asks her advice about men, she says "you don't look like you're enjoying it," and tells her that either way she must not forget to have fun. But meeting Chigaya Niimura is not only for lunch: her aim is to talk over how to end the curse-killings this year at last, at Eiichiro Niimura's thirteenth-year memorial service.

To hear Chigaya Niimura's confession, she makes time and arranges a setting as easy to talk in as possible. Hearing the confession, she does not blame her, but takes her sorrow head-on. After all, she says, with her own past of nearly causing the Megasawa City case, she cannot blame her without hearing the circumstances.

She hears from Chigaya Niimura about the beheading case and how the curse-killings were done. But it all seems puzzling, and she points out various contradictions. Chigaya Niimura asks her to get Erina Goto's help as soon as possible.

While searching the graveyard clearing, she apparently runs into Chigaya Niimura and is told to go to the abandoned hut at once. But finding the footprints on the path to the hut suspicious, she tells Haruka Niimura to get away, even if no one else can.
She joins Natsumi Kogori and the others and reaches the abandoned hut that she says Chigaya Niimura told her about. But Haruka Niimura is nowhere to be seen; she says she sent Haruka away to safety.
